## Summary

`skill/code_review/scripts/linter_runner.py` scoped-lint path hands the raw git changed-file list to eslint without an extension filter. When the changed-file list contains a Python file (.py), eslint v6.4.0 parses it as JavaScript and emits a fatal "Parsing error: Unterminated string constant" — surfaced as a blocking high-severity finding that fails audits closed (Phase 1 decision gate), even though the flagged file is valid Python and unrelated to the item under audit.

discovered-from:SA-0MSKM2LSP006L0K8

## Root cause

- `_run_eslint_findings_check` (`skill/code_review/scripts/linter_runner.py:351`): `cmd = ["eslint", *[str(f) for f in files], "-f", "json", "--quiet"]` — passes raw `files` with no extension filter.
- `_run_eslint_fix_mode` (`:722`, `:727`): same gap.
- By contrast, ruff scoping filters to Python extensions: `py_files = [f for f in files if str(f).endswith((".py", ".pyi", ".pyx"))]` (`:392`, `:641`).
- Consequence (observed 2026-09-20): audit of SA-0MSKM2LSP006L0K8 returned "Ready to close: No" because an unrelated uncommitted `skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_scope.py` modification entered the changed-file scope and eslint mis-parsed it, demoting a previously completed/in_review item to open/plan_complete.

## Reproduction (read-only)

eslint skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_scope.py -f json --quiet  -> fatal "Parsing error: Unterminated string constant" (1:3)
eslint skill/audit/scripts/scan.py -f json --quiet             -> identical error (unrelated committed .py)
eslint tests/node/<any>.mjs -f json --quiet                    -> [] (clean)
python3 -m py_compile skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_scope.py -> OK (valid Python)

Same class of bug as CG-0MSXL2L0T009CA3I (ruff mis-parsing .ts files, 627 false positives) — fixed for ruff but not for eslint.

## Suggested fix

- Filter the scoped `files` list in `_run_eslint_findings_check` / `_run_eslint_fix_mode` to JS/TS extensions (.js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs, .ts, .tsx) before building the eslint command; skip eslint entirely (return []) when no JS/TS targets remain — mirror the ruff guard.
- Whole-project mode (empty/absent files list) already avoids the issue: `eslint <root>` with no explicit targets only lints default JS extensions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Scoped eslint runs filter file targets to JS/TS extensions; a .py-only changed-file list produces zero eslint findings (eslint skipped or given no JS/TS targets).
- [ ] Unit test asserts no eslint invocation / no findings when the scoped file list contains only non-JS/TS files.
- [ ] An audit whose changed-file scope contains only .py files completes without an eslint "Parsing error" blocking finding (regression).
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **SA-0MS1TD0U70018IXR** – Clean remaining references and verify test suite (completed)
- **SA-0MUAG0C7P008X3SE** – Update tests: migrate existing tests, add AC1-AC7 coverage (open)
- **SA-0MSQ012QG005N22S** – Test runner: pytest not found on PATH in non-login shells (open)

### Repository file matches
- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` — matched: 0mskm2lsp006l0k8, absent, acceptance, already, audit (+121 more)
- `docs/dev/audit-skill-reference.md` — matched: 0mskm2lsp006l0k8, absent, acceptance, already, asserts (+114 more)
- `skill/audit/SKILL.md` — matched: 0mskm2lsp006l0k8, absent, acceptance, already, audit (+102 more)
